/sales-quotation.title: Sales Quotation
/sales-quotation.purpose: Price offer to a customer. Pending quotation lines can be pulled into a Sales Order, Challan or Bill.
steps: Choose the date (AD / BS), Cash or Credit, then the customer. Quotation / Order / Challan No. boxes right after the customer pull pending documents of that customer (Enter opens the list).
Add lines: item code or barcode, qty, unit, rate (from the customer's rate type), discount; Add / Less opens the product-wise terms when Item Charges is on.
Check the footer: gross, terms (VAT, discount, freight), net amount; party address / PAN tab can update the master.
Save (or Save as Draft). The action bar also has New, Modify, Cancel, Remove and Print.
/sales-quotation.other: Its qty is "pending" until pulled forward; the Order / Challan / Bill made from it reduces the pending qty.

Quotation Register (Universal Register) lists them with status.
fields: Date of the document. Accounts, stock, VAT month and ageing all use this date. Type it (AD or BS - switch with the AD/BS button) or pick it. A date in a closed fiscal year cannot be posted.

/purchase-additional-expense.title: Purchase Additional Expense
/purchase-additional-expense.purpose: Freight, customs, clearing, insurance, labour ... on purchased goods - taxable or non-taxable bills of other parties, or no bill - allocated to the goods (landed cost).
steps: Ref. Bill No. (required): the posted purchase bill the cost belongs to - only the bill is linked (not the order / GRN); its vendor comes in as the vendor (change it when another party is paid). Older entries linked to an Order / GRN are shown as "Linked (older entry)".

Product-wise Terms tab: the products of the linked document; Terms… on a product opens its terms (Billing Terms marked Purchase Additional + Product Wise) - rate % of that product's value or amount; the whole amount goes to that product's cost.

Bill-wise Terms tab: a fixed form with one row per bill-level term - fill the amounts that apply; each is divided over the products by the term's basis (value / qty, changeable per row). Empty rows are left out.

A term's ledger is fixed by the term - only its sub-ledger can be changed. "Paid to" (the counter ledger) and its sub-ledger are free; empty = the entry's vendor. One row per term: Paid to, Supplier Bill No, Bill Date, VAT % / VAT. The bill type is not chosen - VAT on the row = taxable bill, a bill no without VAT = tax-free bill, neither = no bill. Rows of one party with the same bill no are one bill (taxable + tax-free parts), credited to that party; several bills of several parties fit in one entry.

The header shows the vendor of the Ref. Bill (read only) - there is no cash / credit choice: each line and customs row has its own Credit A/c (vendor, cash, bank, customs agent or any balance-sheet ledger; empty = the Ref. Bill vendor). The basis of a term comes from Billing Terms; the term ledger's Sub-Ledger is picked on the line.

Customs (Bhansar) tab - for the VAT report only, no ledger posting (customs duty / VAT are posted by the Bill-wise or Product-wise terms): one row per Pragyapan Patra - date, Customs Office (from the Customs Offices master), Bill-wise or Item-wise; Assessable, Taxable, Tax-free values, VAT % and VAT (item-wise: per product of the Ref. Bill, summed on the row). The Purchase VAT register lists it as an Import purchase, with the items when item-wise.
Credit A/c and Credit Sub-Ledger on every line (empty = the Ref. Bill vendor and its sub-ledger).

Below: Goods Details (products of the Ref. Bill with additional, net amount, cost / unit), Party Bills / VAT (per party and bill: taxable, VAT, tax-free, less TDS, credited to the party) and Account Posting (the ledger entry that will be posted, Dr = Cr); the Totals panel shows the Net Payable, checked against the party credit of the posting.

TDS: each line has a TDS % - from its Billing Term (TDS Applicable + TDS %; empty = System Control default), changeable on the line (0 = none). With Auto TDS on, one TDS line per party and rate follows every change (amount, party, term, TDS %) by itself - base = that party's lines at that rate, without VAT. Typing on a TDS line turns Auto TDS off; Recalculate TDS rebuilds once.

Totals: Prd. Additional / Non-Additional (product-wise terms), Gen. Additional / Non-Additional (bill-wise terms), Net Additional (goes to the stock cost), Net Non-Additional (VAT claimable, TDS, terms not in costing), Total and Net Total.

fields.Link to Order: Order whose lines this additional expense is allocated to (landed cost).
fields.Link to GRN: GRN whose lines this additional expense is allocated to (landed cost goes into the stock value).
fields.Link to Bill: Purchase bill whose lines this additional expense is allocated to (landed cost).
fields.Term: The billing term of the row. Its ledger is fixed (only the sub-ledger changes); its basis, sign and costing flag come with it.
fields.Ledger / Sub-Ledger: Ledger of the term (fixed by the billing term) and its sub-ledger (changeable). Debited with the amount (credited for a "-" term).
fields.Paid to: Who is paid for this row - the counter ledger (supplier, transporter, cash / labour ledger) and its sub-ledger. Empty = the entry's vendor. Credited with the row total.
fields.Term Used For: Transaction term = charged on the bill itself (Sales / Purchase / Production Entry). Additional term = a later bill on those goods (Purchase / Sales Additional: freight, customs, insurance ...).
fields.Include In Costing: On: the amount goes into the cost of the goods (stock value / landed cost, and so COGS). Off: it stays an expense of the period.
fields.Include In Profitability: On: the amount is counted in the profitability reports (product / bill / party profit).
fields.Date: Date of the document. Accounts, stock, VAT month and ageing all use this date. Type it (AD or BS - switch with the AD/BS button) or pick it. A date in a closed fiscal year cannot be posted.
Number of the document. Given automatically on save from Document Numbering (series per fiscal year); shown as "System series" until then. Manual numbering only if the series allows it.
fields.Doc No: Number of the document. Given automatically on save from Document Numbering (series per fiscal year).
fields.Cash / Credit: Cash: paid / received now - the party field becomes a name (or a cash ledger) and no outstanding is created. Credit: the amount stays outstanding against the party (bill-wise, ageing, credit limit).
fields.Invoice Type: Cash or credit, as Cash / Credit: decides whether the document leaves an outstanding against the party.
fields.Customer: The customer (ledger in Sundry Debtors). Debited with the bill total (credited on a return). PAN, address, credit limit, rate category, agent and area come from the customer master.
fields.Vendor: The supplier (ledger in Sundry Creditors). Credited with the bill total (debited on a return / debit note). PAN, address and credit days come from the vendor master.
fields.Party: The customer / supplier ledger the document is with. Its balance moves with the document.
fields.Customer Sub-Ledger: Sub-ledger (e.g. branch or project of the customer) under the customer ledger. The party posting carries it, so sub-ledger statements and ageing show it.
fields.Vendor Sub-Ledger: Sub-ledger under the vendor ledger. The party posting carries it (sub-ledger statement / ageing).
Pull from a pending quotation of this party: its lines (pending qty only), master part (company, agent, sub-ledger ...), remarks and billing terms come into this entry. Enter on the box opens the list.
Pull from a pending order of this party (pending qty only). Master part, remarks and billing terms come along. The order's delivered / billed qty moves when this entry posts.
Pull from a pending delivery challan. The stock already went out on the challan, so the bill lines from it do not move stock again.
Pull from a pending GRN (goods received). Stock came in on the GRN; the bill clears the GRN clearing account and books the real payable.
Pull from a posted bill of this party (for a return): only the qty not yet returned is offered.
fields.Rate Type: Which selling rate (Sr1 - Sr5) the lines use. Defaults from the customer's rate category; changing it re-rates the lines after asking.
fields.Product Company: Company / brand of the goods on this document. With "Product Company Compulsory" in System Control, only that company's products can be picked and the party posting is split by company (company-wise ledger / ageing).
fields.Warehouse: Warehouse the stock goes out of / comes into (only with Multi Warehouse on). A line can have its own warehouse.
fields.Master Warehouse: Default warehouse for all lines of this document.
fields.Salesman / Agent: Salesman / agent of the sale: used for agent-wise sales, targets and commission.
fields.Agent: Salesman / agent: agent-wise reports, targets and commission.
fields.Salesman/Agent: Salesman / agent: agent-wise reports, targets and commission.
fields.Area: Area of the party / sale - area-wise reports and data access.
fields.Route: Delivery / sales route - route-wise sales, loading sheet and route plan.
fields.Cost Center: Cost center (department, project, site, shed ...) every posting of this document carries: P&L by cost center, budgets.
fields.Unit: Business unit (division / brand) every posting carries: P&L by unit, budgets.
fields.Unit (Business Unit): Business unit every posting carries: P&L by unit, budgets.
fields.Due Date: Payment due date (Date + credit days). Ageing, overdue interest and reminders use it.
fields.Due Days: Credit days; the due date is the document date plus these days.
fields.Currency: Currency of the document (Multi Currency on). Amounts are entered in it; the exchange rate converts them to NPR for accounts.
fields.Priority: Urgency of the document (normal / high / urgent) - for follow-up lists only.
fields.Narration: One line description printed on the voucher and shown in the ledger. Pick a saved remark or type.
fields.Remarks: Remarks printed on the document; pick a saved remark (Remarks master) or type your own.
fields.Terms & Conditions: Terms printed at the bottom of the document (Remarks & Terms master).
fields.Sales Account: Sales (income) account for this document when the product has none. Product account > this account > System Control Sales Account Mapping.
fields.Sales Sub-Ledger: Sub-ledger of the sales account for this document.
fields.Goods Account: Purchase / goods account for this document when the product has none. A fixed asset or stock ledger can be chosen for capital purchases.
fields.Party Bill No: The supplier's own bill number (VAT invoice no). It goes to the purchase VAT register; the same number cannot be entered twice for one supplier.
fields.Party Bill Date: Date on the supplier's bill - VAT register and Annex 13.
fields.Return Reason: Why the goods came back: printed on the credit note, sent to IRD for sales returns.
fields.Settlement Type: How the return is settled: against the bill (adjusts that bill's outstanding) or on account.
fields.Terms: Billing terms (VAT, excise, discount, freight ...) of the document.
fields.Import Declaration No: Customs declaration (pragyapan patra) number of an import - VAT register import columns.
fields.Import Detail Mode: Import taxable / tax-free amounts for the whole bill, or item-wise.
fields.Import Taxable Amount (whole bill): Taxable import value for the VAT register (Annex).
fields.Import Tax-Free Amount (whole bill): Tax-free import value for the VAT register.
fields.PAN Number: PAN / VAT number of the party printed on the bill and used in VAT registers / IRD. Can update the master.
fields.Account Posting: Yes: the expense is posted to the ledgers. No: only the landed cost moves (e.g. already booked elsewhere).
fields.Item Code: Product code or barcode - type or scan; Enter moves on. F1 shows this customer's / supplier's rate history.
fields.Item Name: The product. Its units, rates, accounts, VAT, batch / serial and item type come from the Product Master.
fields.Qty: Quantity in the selected unit. Stock moves in the product's base unit (converted automatically).
fields.Free Qty: Free (scheme) quantity: moves stock, no value.
fields.UOM: Unit of the line (box, pcs, kg ...). Conversion to the base unit comes from Product Units / the product.
fields.Alt Qty: Quantity in the second unit of a dual-unit product (e.g. pcs with cartons).
fields.Rate: Rate per unit (per the rate basis). Sales: from the rate type / rate category / offer rate; purchase: last purchase rate.
fields.Rate Basis: Whether the rate is per the primary or the secondary unit of a dual-unit product.
fields.Gross: Qty x rate before discounts and terms.
fields.Add / Less: Product-wise charges and discounts of the line (from its billing terms popup when Item Charges is on); the popup total shows here.
fields.Net Amount: Gross +/- the line terms: the value of the line.
fields.Disc %: Line discount percent (a Discount billing term when term mapping is used).
fields.Tax %: VAT percent of the line (13% for taxable goods, 0 for exempt).
fields.Batch: Batch / lot number (Batch System on). Stock and batch-wise costing follow it.
fields.Serial No: Serial number of the piece (Serial Number on) - vehicles, electronics.
fields.Exp Date: Expiry date of the batch - near-expiry alerts and stock ageing.
fields.Ref No (source doc): The document this line was pulled from (quotation / order / challan / GRN / bill).
fields.Gross Amount: Total of the lines before document-level terms.
fields.Net Amount (total): Amount after all terms and VAT - the party is debited / credited with it.
fields.Base: Amount TDS is worked out on (default: the bill value without VAT).
fields.TDS %: TDS rate. TDS amount = base x %. Sales: TDS the customer withholds (Dr TDS receivable, Cr customer). Purchase: TDS we withhold (Dr supplier, Cr TDS payable).
fields.TDS Amount: TDS in rupees; typed or worked out from base x %.
fields.TDS Ledger: TDS payable (purchase) or TDS receivable (sales) ledger; defaults from System Control.
fields.TDS Sub-Ledger: Sub-ledger of the TDS ledger (e.g. TDS type / section).
fields.JV Type: Kind of journal: Normal, Taxable / non-taxable Purchase or Sales, Asset Purchase / Sale, Service Purchase / Sale, or TDS (on purchase / on sales). Purchase / sales types go to the VAT register; the lines are filled from the amounts.
fields.Taxable Amount: Value on which VAT is charged (JV purchase / sales).
fields.VAT %: VAT rate (13%); VAT amount = taxable x %.
fields.VAT Amount: VAT of the journal - posted to the VAT A/c and to the VAT register.
fields.VAT A/c: VAT ledger the VAT goes to (defaults from System Control).
fields.Bill Total: Taxable + non-taxable + VAT: the party amount.
fields.Ref Doc No: Reference document (supplier bill no for a purchase).
fields.Bill Date: Date of the supplier / customer bill.
fields.Memo Only: A memo journal is recorded but not posted to the ledgers.
fields.Receipt / Payment: Receipt: money comes in (Dr cash / bank, Cr the lines). Payment: money goes out (Cr cash / bank, Dr the lines).
fields.Cash / Bank: Whether the cash or a bank account is used.
fields.Cash/Bank Ledger: The cash-in-hand or bank ledger debited (receipt) or credited (payment).
fields.Mode: Cash, cheque, transfer, wallet ... printed and used by bank reconciliation.
fields.Cheque / Txn No: Cheque or transaction number - bank reconciliation matches it with the statement.
fields.Document No: Reference number (receipt book no, bank slip no).
fields.Document Date: Date of the reference document / cheque.
fields.Received / Issued: Received: a post-dated cheque from a customer. Issued: our post-dated cheque to a supplier. Nothing posts to the ledger until the cheque is deposited / cleared.
fields.Cheque Date: Date on the cheque; the PDC dashboard shows due / overdue cheques by it.
fields.Bank Ledger: Bank the cheque is deposited to / paid from when it clears.
fields.Amount: Amount of the line / cheque / document.
fields.From Branch: Sending branch (branch transfer: goods in transit until received).
fields.Transfer Type: Direct (in and out together) or two-step branch transfer (dispatch, then receipt).
fields.Receiving Date: Date the goods were received at the other branch.
fields.Vehicle No: Vehicle carrying the goods - printed on the challan / transfer.
fields.Output Product: Finished / semi-finished product made. Stock in at the cost of the raw materials (less by-products) per base unit.
fields.Source Warehouse (Raw Material): Warehouse the raw materials are taken from.
fields.Output Relative Value: Share of cost for the main output when there are joint products (relative sales value).
fields.Account Group: Group the ledger belongs to - decides Balance Sheet / P&L place, Trial Balance and ratio / cash-flow category.
fields.Category Type: Customer, supplier, both, cash, bank or others - decides where the ledger is offered (party pickers, cash / bank).
fields.Opening Balance: Balance on the first day of the opening fiscal year (Dr / Cr).
fields.Credit Limit / Days: Maximum outstanding and credit days allowed - warned / blocked on sales per Credit Limit Control.
fields.Credit Limit Control: None, warn or block when a sale takes the party over its credit limit.
fields.Bill-wise Tracking: Keep the party's outstanding bill by bill (bill-wise ageing, settlement of payments against bills).
fields.Sub Ledger Mode: Whether this ledger uses sub-ledgers and which.
fields.VAT/PAN Number: PAN / VAT number - printed on bills, VAT register, IRD, confirmation letters.
fields.Billing Name: Name printed on bills (if different from the ledger name); confirmation letters can group ledgers by it.
fields.Rate Category: Which selling rate (Sr1 - Sr5) this customer gets by default.
fields.Discount Category: Default discount group of the customer.
Interest on overdue bills (Interest on Overdue posting).
fields.Item Type: Trading item, raw material, semi-finished, finished good, service, non-inventory or fixed asset. Service, non-inventory and fixed asset are not stock (no stock movement, not in closing stock).
fields.Primary Unit: Base unit of the product: stock is kept in it.
fields.Unit Mode: Single unit, multiple units with conversion, or dual unit (two quantities per line).
fields.Stock Group: Product group - group-wise stock and sales reports.
fields.Company / Brand: Product company - company-wise sales, purchase and compulsory company rules.
fields.Default Vendor: Usual supplier - used by purchase plans.
fields.Short Name: Short name / alias for quick search.
fields.Short Name (Alias): Short name / alias for quick search.
fields.Code: Code of the record - automatic and read-only.
fields.Tags: Free labels for searching and grouping.
fields.From: First date of the report period.
fields.To: Last date of the report period.
fields.From Date: First date of the report period.
fields.To Date: Last date of the report period.
fields.As on: Report position at the end of this date (balances, stock, ageing).
fields.Show: Which rows to show (all / only differences / ...).
fields.Group by: How the rows are grouped / totalled.
fields.Documents: Which document types are included. The book buttons tick a whole book at once (bills + JVs + additional bills).
fields.Customer / Supplier: Limit the report to one party.
fields.Method: Stock valuation method: FIFO, moving average, weighted average ...
fields.IRD Billing: Yes: a posted Sales Bill / Sales Return can only be cancelled (IRD rules), is kept in the IRD register and can be pushed to CBMS.
fields.VAT Ledger Mapping: Default VAT ledger for line VAT on sales and purchase.
fields.Negative Stock Control: None / warn / block when a sale, return, transfer or adjustment would take stock below zero.
fields.Multi Warehouse: Yes: warehouse on entries and warehouse-wise stock.
fields.Batch System: Yes: batch / lot on stock entries and batch-wise stock.
fields.Multi Currency System: Yes: foreign-currency documents with exchange rates.
fields.Default VAT %: VAT rate used when a line has none (13%).
fields.Default TDS %: TDS rate offered on bills / JVs.
fields.TDS Payable Ledger (purchase): Ledger for TDS we withhold from suppliers.
fields.TDS Receivable Ledger (sales): Ledger for TDS customers withhold from us.
fields.Sales Account Mapping: Default sales account (when neither product nor document has one).
fields.GRN Clearing Ledger (GR/IR): Provisional liability for goods received before the bill (Cr at GRN, Dr at bill).
fields.Post Stock Adjustment to Accounts: Yes: stock adjustments post to the ledgers (shortage / damage / excess accounts).
fields.Back-date Entry Control: How far back an entry may be dated.
fields.Post-date Entry Control: How far ahead an entry may be dated.
